name: Glute Bridge with Knee Lift
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart, and arms resting along your sides.
Squeeze your glutes and push through your heels to lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from knees to shoulders.
Holding your hips level and steady, lift your right foot off the floor and bring your knee toward your chest at a 90-degree angle.
Lower the right foot back down without allowing your pelvis to drop or rotate.
Repeat the march with your left foot while keeping your glutes engaged and hips elevated.
coaching_cues: Keep your pelvis level like a table; do not allow one hip to dip as you lift the opposite leg.
Lift with your glutes rather than arching with your lower back.
